Messages.Author: Big Eye
Messages.Body:
Hi everyone. Vamp A is involved in combat with another minion during
pre-range Vamp B (belonging to the same circle) plays Octopod san, and
then draws into another Octopod, can Vamp C (also belonging to same
circle) then play Octopod SAN?

Collectively we said no because you can only gain additional strikes
from one source, but I wanted to be sure we came to the right
conclusion.

Thanks,

Jeff

Octopod
Cost: 1 blood

Requires a ready Blood Brother of the same circle as another one in
combat. Usable by a vampire not involved in the combat.
[san] Only usable before range is chosen. The other Blood Brother gets
an additional strike each round this combat (this counts as his or her
one source of additional strikes).
[SAN] As [san] above, but with two additional strikes each round.

Messages.Author: alex fnurp
Messages.Body:

Hello, i am the VTES rulebook and I love you. Im going to spread out
to section 6.4.3 "Strike" and here we find the following:
"A minion cannot use more than one card or effect to gain additional
strikes per round of combat."

Thank you for using me. <3
